## Vendor documentation

Where is the manual for this switch, router, or firewall?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Cisco Support](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/index.html) | Cisco | Cisco's support hub: look up a product to reach its documentation and security notices, or browse by resource type. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [HPE Networking Documentation](https://networkingdocs.hpe.com/documentation/) | Hewlett Packard Enterprise | Documentation for HPE's Juniper and Aruba networking products: technical guides, release notes, and configuration resources, chosen by product. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Arista Product Documentation Library](https://www.arista.com/en/support/product-documentation) | Arista Networks | Arista's manuals under tabs for software, hardware, policies, and packaging, including the EOS configuration guide and CloudVision guides. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Fortinet Document Library](https://docs.fortinet.com/) | Fortinet | Fortinet's product documentation, arranged by solution area such as secure networking and SASE, with an upgrade guide and outbreak alerts linked from the front page. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Palo Alto Networks TechDocs](https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/) | Palo Alto Networks | Palo Alto Networks' documentation portal, arranged by portfolio, from next-generation firewalls and secure access service edge to AI security. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Cisco Meraki Documentation](https://documentation.meraki.com/) | Cisco | Cisco Meraki's documentation, split into wireless, switching, SD-WAN and SASE, IoT, and platform management, with a getting-started section. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [RouterOS Manual](https://manual.mikrotik.com/docs/introduction/) | MikroTik | MikroTik's manual for RouterOS, the operating system on its wireless devices, switches, and routers, with a CLI reference and a dated changelog for the manual. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [pfSense Documentation](https://docs.netgate.com/pfsense/en/latest/) | Netgate (Rubicon Communications LLC) | Netgate's documentation for pfSense software, with configuration recipes; also offered as PDF and ePub. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [OPNsense documentation](https://docs.opnsense.org/) | Deciso B.V. | Documentation for OPNsense, the open source firewall and routing platform built on FreeBSD. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [NVIDIA Networking Documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/networking-ethernet-software/) | NVIDIA | User guides and release notes for NVIDIA's Cumulus Linux network operating system, NetQ, and DSX Air, with technical guides and a knowledge base. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [VyOS User Guide](https://docs.vyos.io/en/rolling/) | VyOS | VyOS's guide: getting or building an image, installing on bare metal, in a VM, or in a cloud, then configuring, operating, and automating it. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [FRRouting User Guide](https://docs.frrouting.org/en/latest/) | FRRouting | User guide for FRR, the free IP routing suite that implements BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RIP, and other protocols. | Vendor documentation | Free |

## Protocols and standards

What does the protocol actually say?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [IETF Datatracker](https://datatracker.ietf.org/) | IETF | The IETF's working database: search its documents and see working groups, meetings, agendas, and minutes. | Reference | Free |
| [RFC Editor](https://www.rfc-editor.org/) | IETF | The official home of the RFC series: browse RFCs by category or subject, see the latest ones, and read about errata. | Reference | Free |
| [RFC 4271: A Border Gateway Protocol 4 (BGP-4)](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc4271/) | IETF | Specifies BGP-4, the routing protocol that autonomous systems use to exchange reachability information; later RFCs update it. | Standard | Free |
| [RFC 2328: OSPF Version 2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc2328/) | IETF | Defines OSPF version 2, the link-state protocol for routing inside one autonomous system; Internet Standard 54, updated by later RFCs. | Standard | Free |
| [RFC 1918: Address Allocation for Private Internets](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc1918/) | IETF | Sets aside the private IPv4 blocks 10/8, 172.16/12, and 192.168/16; published as Best Current Practice 5. | Standard | Free |
| [RFC 8200: Internet Protocol, Version 6 (IPv6) Specification](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc8200/) | IETF | Specifies IPv6; it is Internet Standard 86 and obsoletes RFC 2460. | Standard | Free |
| [RFC 9293: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP)](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9293/) | IETF | The current TCP specification, Internet Standard 7 from 2022; it replaces RFC 793 and gathers the changes made to it since. | Standard | Free |
| [RFC 2131: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc2131/) | IETF | Specifies DHCP, which hands network configuration to hosts and extends BOOTP with automatic allocation of reusable addresses. | Standard | Free |
| [IEEE 802.1 Working Group](https://1.ieee802.org/) | IEEE 802 | Home of the IEEE 802.1 group, which writes standards for LAN and MAN architecture, internetworking, security, and network management, including Time-Sensitive Networking. | Organization | Free |

## Registries and numbering

Who holds this address block, AS number, or port?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Protocol Registries (IANA)](https://www.iana.org/protocols) | IANA (Public Technical Identifiers, an affiliate of ICANN) | IANA's index of the registries that record the codes and numbers used in Internet protocols. | Reference | Free |
| [Service Name and Transport Protocol Port Number Registry](https://www.iana.org/assignments/service-names-port-numbers) | IANA (Public Technical Identifiers, an affiliate of ICANN) | IANA's registry of assigned TCP, UDP, SCTP, and DCCP port numbers and service names, available as CSV, XML, HTML, and TXT. | Reference | Free |
| [IPv4 Special-Purpose Address Space](https://www.iana.org/assignments/iana-ipv4-special-registry) | IANA (Public Technical Identifiers, an affiliate of ICANN) | IANA's registry of IPv4 address blocks set aside for special purposes, available as XML, HTML, TXT, and CSV. | Reference | Free |
| [American Registry for Internet Numbers (ARIN)](https://www.arin.net/) | American Registry for Internet Numbers | The nonprofit, member-based registry that administers IP addresses and AS numbers: requests, transfers, Whois, and routing security services. | Organization | Free |
| [RIPE NCC](https://www.ripe.net/) | RIPE NCC | The Internet number registry for Europe, Central Asia, and the Middle East: it registers IP addresses and AS numbers and is the RIPE community's secretariat. | Organization | Free |
| [APNIC](https://www.apnic.net/) | APNIC | The Regional Internet Registry for the Asia Pacific: getting and transferring IP addresses, moving to IPv6, and ways to take part. | Organization | Free |
| [LACNIC](https://www.lacnic.net/en) | LACNIC | The Internet address registry for Latin America and the Caribbean: resource requests, Whois, IPv6 deployment, events, tools, and R+D reports. | Organization | Free |
| [AFRINIC](https://afrinic.net/) | African Network Information Centre (AFRINIC) | The registry that allocates and manages IPv4, IPv6, and AS number resources in Africa, with its news and Whois. | Organization | Free |
| [PeeringDB](https://www.peeringdb.com/) | PeeringDB | Database of networks, Internet exchanges, facilities, and carriers that its users maintain, free to use and consulted when making interconnection decisions. | Dataset or feed | Free |
| [ICANN Lookup](https://lookup.icann.org/en) | ICANN | ICANN's tool for current registration data: type in a domain name, IP network, or AS number, and it fetches the record over RDAP. | Online service | Free |

## Lookup and diagnostic tools

How do I see what the network is doing?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BGP.Tools](https://bgp.tools/) | Port 179 Ltd | Search by ASN, prefix, DNS name, or MAC address for near-realtime BGP data; network monitoring and API credits are for paid users. | Online service | Freemium |
| [RIPEstat](https://stat.ripe.net/) | RIPE NCC | Look up an IP address, ASN, hostname, or country code and see data and visualisations about it, as widgets or through a data API. | Online service | Free |
| [RIPE Atlas](https://atlas.ripe.net/) | RIPE NCC | The RIPE NCC's Internet measurement system of probes and anchors: browse its public measurements, maps, and statistics, or run your own with a free account. | Online service | Free with account |
| [DNSViz](https://dnsviz.net/) | Casey Deccio | Enter a domain name to get a diagram of its DNSSEC authentication chain, with the configuration errors the tool found. | Online service | Free |
| [iperf3](https://github.com/esnet/iperf) | ESnet (Energy Sciences Network) | Measures the maximum bandwidth achievable on an IP network over TCP, UDP, or SCTP; maintained by ESnet. | Tool | Free |
| [mtr](https://github.com/traviscross/mtr) | Travis Cross (traviscross) | Network diagnostic tool that does the work of traceroute and ping in one program. | Tool | Free |
| [NetBox](https://github.com/netbox-community/netbox) | NetBox Community | Open source application for documenting and modeling a network, from cabling to device configuration, kept as the authoritative record for network automation. | Tool | Free |
| [Test your IPv6](https://test-ipv6.com/) | APNIC Labs | Tests whether your browser and connection can reach sites over IPv6, and displays the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses you are using. | Online service | Free |
| [RouteViews](https://www.routeviews.org/routeviews/) | University of Oregon (Network Startup Resource Center) | Archive of BGP routing data collected from networks around the world, free for operations and research with attribution. | Dataset or feed | Free |
| [tcpdump and libpcap](https://www.tcpdump.org/) | The Tcpdump Group | Project site for the tcpdump packet analyzer, a command-line tool, and for libpcap, a library for capturing network traffic, with releases, man pages, and documentation. | Tool | Free |
